title: Dashboard mark read updates the inbox service
goal: The dashboard action marks every covered delivered reminder read before saving its visit cursor
acceptance: A failing-first join test loads the dashboard Mark as read handler and exercises the authenticated inbox read endpoint and Telegram fallback
Every delivered reminder covered by the visit cursor is posted to /api/inbox/<id>/read; deliveries outside the panel remain unread
The dashboard visit cursor is stored only after all service reads succeed
privacy: Use neutral invented reminder text and local temporary service data only.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 for a failing-first join test, the dashboard service calls and CI. Not a measurement.
